segments.he: שְׁתֵּי חֲבוּרוֹת וְכוּ׳. תָּנָא: אִם יֵשׁ שַׁמָּשׁ בֵּינֵיהֶם — שַׁמָּשׁ מְצָרְפָן.
segments.en: The mishna explained the circumstances in which «two groups» that were eating in one house may combine to form a zimmun. The Gemara adds: «It was taught: If there is a» common «waiter among them,» serving both groups, «the waiter joins them» into a single group, even if they cannot see each other.

moves.summary: The Gemara cites the mishna's clause on two groups eating in one house.

moves.summary: A baraita supplements: a common waiter joins the two groups into one, even if they cannot see each other.
